alexcrichton opened PR #14745 from alexcrichton:fix-flaky-test to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit adds some more synchronization to the wasip1 implementation of poll_oneoff. This destruction was already mostly happening in an associated destructor but the destructor couldn't call async functions which are needed for full synchronization on all platforms.
